name: @local/dsh-context-rag
description: Adds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to DeepSeek Harness sessions: stores each turn's (user message, final assistant reply) pair in a human-readable JSONL store, indexes embeddings in SQLite, and injects related past turns from the current workspace (or all workspaces) as read-only context before each model step.

scripts.check: for f in index.js client.js lib/*.js test/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
